fdbanner_check: Screenshot is byte-identical to the visually verified PIT-retest banner.
notes: C: is the writable FAT16 disk; D: in the read-only test is the ISO9660 CD. No drive letter assignment was changed.
AH=39h makes one directory; AH=3Ah removes an empty directory. Paths resolve within the selected DOS drive and preserve CWD on failure.
Missing/not-a-directory paths map to AX=3; existing/nonempty/denied/read-only destinations to AX=5; current-directory removal to AX=16. CF reports failure. Mounted roots are protected.
Windows advances past directory creation into the next preparation/information screen; a full installation and Windows desktop were not tested.
Original media and executables unchanged. Writable test-image copies only; no APK rebuild or release.
